note: Miyamoto et al. (2026) report that affected RAB3A p.Arg83Trp carriers present consistently with adult-onset cerebellar ataxia, whereas neurodevelopmental features are described as variable.

evidence.text: Affected individuals with the RAB3A p.Arg83Trp variant in two families presented with adult-onset progressive cerebellar ataxia, while features of neurodevelopmental disorders were described as variable.

source.title: An R83W mutation in Rab3A causes autosomal-dominant cerebellar ataxia
source.quote: Affected individuals presented with adult-onset, gradually progressive cerebellar symptoms, often accompanied by mild gait spasticity and tremors. Variable features of neurodevelopmental disorders were also observed.
